cueCard.topic: Describe a gift that you gave to someone.
cueCard.explain: and explain how the person felt when they received it.

questions.text: Describe a gift that you gave to someone.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a gift that you gave to someone. You should say: who you gave it to; what the gift was; why you chose it; and explain how the person felt when they received it.

questions.text: Do you enjoy choosing presents for people?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you enjoy choosing presents for people?

questions.text: On what occasions do people give gifts in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a gift you gave to someone, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all giving gifts. On what occasions do people give gifts in your country?

questions.text: Is an expensive gift always better than a cheap one?
